component.inactive_age_note: Inactive age overshoot is not used as visual evidence; active projectile/impact state and cleanup are checked separately.

test_runner_notes: First invocation found three GDScript type-inference errors in new test locals, before any assertions ran. Explicit bool/String annotations fixed the test fixture; no production code was changed. The headless rerun directs its log to /private/tmp because the sandbox cannot write the default user log directory.

scope: Independent headless state/clock/pose/component review. No GPU, frame-rate benchmark, gameplay damage or visual acceptance.
